verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a Unified Controls model in which auditors mapped all offered frameworks to a single core control list. The docs describe "deep cross-framework mapping" with "no duplicate work" and unified action items, so adding a new framework surfaces only the new actions. You can filter unified controls by framework, view framework controls alongside unified ones, and look up a unified control by its HIPAA control. Missing for 10: explicit mention of ISO 27001 in the mapping, a documented overlap or coverage visualization between frameworks, explicit documentation that collected evidence auto-satisfies requests across frameworks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
